caveats: The CatBoost residual on thinned inputs is the coverage campaign's declared approximation; the residual is identical for control and candidate.
July EDDF is harsher than July 2026 (64.9% vs 76.1% matched).
December's thinning (a13_dec) touches EDDF only, so LIRF inputs are natural there; July is the informative month for round B.
control: v27's LIRF blends (v25's weights, ens_nnl) with v27's committee mix (ens_ctx, share 0.65) -- round B's declared control; LIRF rows equal v28's
descriptive: gain retained (thinned / natural change) on all rows and on LIRF
LIRF matched / unmatched readings on each regime
gate: The selection proceeds to export if, on BOTH thinned months, the candidate's whole-month RMSE is below the thinned control's AND the paired-day 95% interval (run_adsb_v11.paired_days, seed of configs/adsb_rnn_v1.json) of the RMSE difference lies below zero. Otherwise no export without the user's decision. This check can only block; it never changes the selected candidate or its weights.
method: As configs/adsb_ctx_regime_check_v2.json (tools/ctx_lirf_regime_check.py): same thinned months and attempts (July 2025 thins LIRF to its July 2026 coverage), token rebuild that must reproduce the stored token file, member folds (December: January-November refit models; July: seasonal models); ens_ctx from the round-1 check's saved re-predictions, ens_nnl natural/thinned from the coverage campaign's saved tables, ens_ctx_lirf re-predicted from its 16 learners. Only LIRF rows may differ between control and candidate.
The natural control must reproduce v27's recorded development RMSE and the natural candidate its round-B development RMSE within 0.01 s.
purpose: Ship check for round B's selected candidate (configs/adsb_ctx_lirf_v1.json, docs/adsb_ctx_lirf/development_results.json): does its LIRF gain survive the ranking months' adsb.lol coverage, in particular July 2026's dark LIRF? Declared after that selection and before any thinned score of ens_ctx_lirf or of the candidate.

regimes.2025-07: a13_jul (EDDF, LSZH, LIRF thinned to July 2026 coverage; EDDF harsher than July 2026, an upper bound)
